column1: # doc-owners.tsv — which docs page owns which path (read by scripts/doc-owners.sh).
# Format: glob<TAB>page<TAB>why, one row per glob; blank lines and lines starting
# with # are ignored. The glob is a shell `case` pattern limited to * and ?, and
# * also matches /. The page is an existing docs/<name>.md; one page per row.
# This file mirrors the path-mappable rows of docs/index.md §Documentation
# maintenance rules: the table and this file change together, and
# internal/repodocs/doc_owners_test.go fails when a mapped page is not in the table.
# Rows that cannot be a glob are left out on purpose: the lint check row (the
# data-plane.md §Check catalogue is generated and `make gate` fails when it is
# stale), skill/service/secret handling, deferred features, project status, new
# dependencies, the Atlas UI and the demo rows (driven by build outputs, not by one
# A row ships only when, over a sample of recent first-parent commits, the page is
# untouched in at most half of the commits that cross the 10-line floor. internal/gitx
# is mapped to realign.go only: the package as a whole failed that rule.
